ctx.x: Pee Wee Jackson was a trumpet player from Chicago who had formerly been with the Jimmie Lunceford band. Pee Wee Jackson and Freddie Webster were sidekicks in the Lunceford band. He was a very ebullient, big-smile cat. Played good trumpet. He, I think, ended up being sent out in the Treasure Island band, out in California.
You mentioned Freddie Webster. Did you know Freddie Webster?
